scripts.checks:ownership:forbid-msg-sender-owner: sh -c 'if rg "__Ownable_init\\(msg\\.sender\\)" src -g"*.sol"; then echo "ERROR: forbidden __Ownable_init(msg.sender) (use __Ownable_init(initialOwner))"; exit 1; fi'

scripts.checks:ownership:require-nonzero-owner-c: sh -c 'rg "initialOwner\\s*==\\s*address\\(0\\)" src -g"*.sol" || { echo "ERROR: expected nonzero guard for initialOwner (initialOwner == address(0) / revert)"; exit 1; }'
